title: Q-CIFAIL-github-openstd: openstd is failing in ultrastable/.github
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/.github openstd
**Status:** closed

CIWATCH-1: workflow `openstd` in ultrastable/.github is red on its default branch (failure, 2026-11-26T23:04:46Z): https://github.com/ultrastable/.github/actions/runs/45908735834

Fix the root cause in the repository where the defect lives; do not skip or weaken the check. Failed log tail:

```
openstd	Run python3 tools/openstd.py	﻿2026-11-26T23:04:50.7164001Z ##[group]Run python3 tools/openstd.py
```

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T05:12:40Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
